stories.title: EN DIRECT - Mouvement des lycéens : 90% des universités «bloquées» ou «fermées» selon un syndicat, les forces de l’ordre visées à Marseille

en.title: LIVE - Student movement: 90% of universities 'blocked' or 'closed' according to union, police targeted in Marseille
en.summary: High school and university students resumed blockades on Tuesday morning, claiming inadequate government concessions, ahead of a planned national protest day as authorities anticipate the movement may lose momentum.

stories.title: Mobilisation lycéenne : "90%" des facultés "bloquées ou fermées" ce mardi, selon l'Union étudiante, un chiffre contesté par le ministère

en.title: Student mobilization: '90%' of universities 'blocked or closed' on Tuesday, according to student union, a figure contested by the ministry
en.summary: High school students protested again on Tuesday, just days before autumn school holidays, with disputes over the scale of disruptions to higher education institutions.

stories.title: Un piratage "pas si sophistiqué que ça" : ce que l'on sait de la cyberattaque qui a fait monter en température les frigos de supermarchés

en.title: A cyberattack 'not so sophisticated' after all: what we know about the hack that caused supermarket refrigerator temperatures to spike
en.summary: Hackers gained remote control of thermostats in hundreds of supermarket refrigeration units over the weekend, forcing affected stores to discard perishable goods due to temperature manipulation.

stories.title: La Hongrie adopte une première loi supprimant des dispositions anti-LGBT+ de l'ère Orban

en.title: Hungary adopts first law eliminating anti-LGBT+ provisions from Orban era
en.summary: Hungarian lawmakers voted Tuesday to remove anti-LGBT+ clauses from a 2021 child protection law, marking the first significant rollback of LGBT+ restrictions under Prime Minister Péter Magyar's administration.

stories.title: La Hongrie adopte une première loi supprimant des dispositions anti-LGBT+ de l'ère Viktor Orban

en.title: Hungary adopts first law removing anti-LGBT+ provisions from Viktor Orban era
en.summary: Hungary has passed legislation eliminating anti-LGBT+ restrictions that were implemented under Viktor Orban's government. This marks the first significant reversal of such policies since Peter Magyar took office.

stories.title: En Hongrie, la majorité pro-européenne commence à détricoter les lois anti-LGBT + d’Orban

en.title: In Hungary, pro-European majority begins dismantling Orban's anti-LGBT+ laws
en.summary: Hungarian lawmakers voted to remove anti-LGBT+ provisions from a 2021 child protection law that was adopted by Viktor Orban and criticized by the European Union. The pro-European majority is reversing these restrictions.

stories.title: Le PDG de Coopérative U tempère les dégâts de la cyberattaque des frigos de supermarchés

en.title: CEO of Coopérative U downplays damage from supermarket refrigerator cyberattack
en.summary: The head of Coopérative U stated that only a minority of the 80 stores affected by a cyberattack on refrigeration units had to discard merchandise. The damage impact was described as limited.

stories.title: Carburants : la hausse des prix a fait baisser les recettes fiscales de l’État de 357 millions d'euros, selon Bercy

en.title: Fuel prices: rise in prices reduced state's tax revenue by 357 million euros, according to Bercy
en.summary: Rising fuel prices have actually decreased government tax revenues by 357 million euros year-to-date, contrary to the assumption that higher prices benefit the state. Lower consumption volumes and reduced excise revenues are responsible for the shortfall.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, mouvement lycéen : 90 % des universités sont « bloquées » ou « fermées », selon l’Union étudiante. Suivez la journée de mobilisation en direct

en.title: LIVE: Student movement: 90% of universities are "blocked" or "closed", according to the Student Union. Follow the mobilization day live
en.summary: University students have joined high school protests across France, with approximately 200 of 3,700 high schools potentially closing. Demonstrations are planned in major cities including Paris, Lyon, Marseille, Lille, Toulouse, and Bordeaux.

stories.title: En France, les émissions de gaz à effet de serre en baisse en 2026, mais le rythme reste trop lent

en.title: In France, greenhouse gas emissions down in 2026, but the pace remains too slow
en.summary: French greenhouse gas emissions decreased by 4.1% in the first half of 2026 and are projected to fall 2.8% for the full year, largely due to reduced fuel consumption driven by record-high fuel prices.

stories.title: Les émissions de gaz à effet de serre en France diminuent du fait de l’envolée des prix des carburants

en.title: Greenhouse gas emissions in France decrease due to soaring fuel prices
en.summary: French greenhouse gas emissions dropped 4.1% in the first half of 2026 with a projected 2.8% decline for the full year, according to emissions monitoring authorities.

stories.title: Faille logicielle, frigos à 35 °C, des millions d’euros perdus : les dessous de la cyberattaque inédite qui a frappé les supermarchés français

en.title: Software flaw, refrigerators at 35°C, millions of euros lost: details of unprecedented cyberattack on French supermarkets
en.summary: A major cyberattack targeted refrigeration infrastructure at leading French retail chains, disrupting a critical component of the country's food supply chain and causing substantial financial losses.

stories.title: Bilan des lancements orbitaux de septembre 2026

en.title: Overview of orbital launches in September 2026
en.summary: September 2026 saw sustained orbital launch activity with a new peak in Chinese launches and successful missions by three new space agencies.

stories.title: Data centers : pourquoi les frappes de drones sur Yandex en Russie inquiètent le secteur du cloud

en.title: Data centers: why drone strikes on Yandex in Russia worry the cloud sector
en.summary: Russian cloud giant Yandex suffered major service disruptions after three drone strikes last week, highlighting the physical vulnerability of data centers to hybrid attacks and risks of data loss for businesses.

stories.title: OPINION. « Les énergies renouvelables dans un imbroglio politico-judiciaire »

en.title: OPINION. "Renewable energies in a political-legal tangle"
en.summary: While renewable energy sources like wind and solar appear cost-free, they require substantial upfront capital investment in production and grid connection infrastructure, leading many countries to offer financial incentives to private investors.

stories.title: OPINION. « Automobile : face à la Chine, la France a une méthode gagnante. Pourquoi ne pas la généraliser ? »

en.title: OPINION. "Automobiles: facing China, France has a winning method. Why not generalize it?"
en.summary: China's manufacturing sector now represents nearly one-third of global industrial capacity, with significant production advantages demonstrated by rapid robot adoption and automakers like Xiaomi achieving high sales volumes at competitive costs.

stories.title: OPINION. « Pourquoi les maîtres de l’IA rêvent-ils de l’Empire romain »

en.title: OPINION. "Why masters of AI dream of the Roman Empire"
en.summary: Major AI technology leaders reference ancient Rome in their work, with figures like Mark Zuckerberg and Elon Musk drawing inspiration from Roman history, raising questions about how such historical references influence the development of transformative technologies.
